We sincerely apologize for your disappointing experience at Hotel Mamacha Vada.

We are truly sorry to hear that the mutton and chicken gravy masala did not meet your expectations and felt too spicy with a similar taste. Your feedback is very important to us, and we take it seriously.

Our Malvani-style dishes are traditionally flavorful and slightly spicy, but we always aim to balance taste and quality. We will definitely review this with our kitchen team to ensure better consistency and improved flavors.

We would appreciate another opportunity to serve you and provide a much better dining experience. Please feel free to visit us again and let us know your spice preference — we’ll be happy to customize it for you.

Thank you for sharing your honest feedback.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Thipireddy
featured_reviews.review_text: The perfect place in Virar west to go for having Shawarmaa! Visited this place yesterday as part of lockdown but they are open for takeaway till 10pm. They have lovely taste, fresh chicken and enough size and quantity of the bread as well as the chicken. Overall delicious shawarma is what they serve. Must try for all of you when in Virar west near Gokul township. As I still consider this as under rated place in Virar for shawarma, but they are one of the best!

featured_reviews.name: Dhwani Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best shawarma places in Virar, serving a delicious variety including khaboos, tortilla, and open shawarmas. The regular tortilla and hot & spicy shawarma are my absolute favorites. They use a good amount of chicken instead of just loading it with mayo and bread, and also add cabbage, fries, and beetroot for a nice crunch. The mayo tastes fresh and not synthetic, giving the shawarma a perfectly balanced flavor. The filling is generous, and one tortilla shawarma is enough to fill your stomach. The best part is that it’s affordable, with prices starting from just ₹80. It does get a little crowded on weekends, so you might have to wait in a queue, but the service is very quick. There are also a few chairs available if you want to sit and enjoy.
